verdict.rationale: Statsig's own platform docs give one pricing fact: a free allowance of feature flags plus 2 million metered events. That signals metered events as a cost driver, but no full published price list appears. Missing for 10: a published pricing page with tiers and per-unit prices, clarity on whether seats, MAUs or requests affect cost, overage and paid-tier details, and independent corroboration of pricing transparency.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can see published pricing and understand what drives cost (seats, MAUs, events, requests) before committing

citations.quote: You get feature flags and 2 million metered events for free.
